projects.status: Public BPS patch v1.0.1 released 2026-10-05; the update fixes three bugs. The full game is translated in right-to-left Arabic with joined letter shaping. The CGB's second VRAM bank is required, so original DMG hardware and DMG-mode emulation are unsupported. A save created on v1.0 preserves a previously blank rival name after the update.
projects.summary: Complete Arabic fan localization of Pokémon Crystal, including a custom right-to-left text engine and joined Arabic glyphs across dialogue, menus and other game text. The public BPS patch requires the US/Europe v1.0 ROM with SHA-1 f4cd194bdee0d04ca4eac29e09b8e4e9d818c133; no ROM is distributed. The GitHub repository has release notes and patch assets but no explicit source-code licence was found.
